001package io.github.ai4ci.config.setup;
002
003import org.immutables.value.Value;
004import org.jgrapht.generate.WattsStrogatzGraphGenerator;
005import org.jgrapht.graph.DefaultEdge;
006import org.jgrapht.graph.SimpleGraph;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeName;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
012
013import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person;
014
015/**
016 * Watts‑Strogatz network configuration.
017 *
018 * <p>
019 * This configuration encapsulates parameters used to generate a small‑world
020 * social network using the JGraphT {@code WattsStrogatzGraphGenerator}. It is
021 * consumed by network construction code in the model builder during the setup
022 * stage and is not used directly during simulation runtime.
023 *
024 * <p>
025 * Downstream uses: passed to the builder's
026 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.builders.DefaultModelBuilder#setupOutbreak} which
027 * invokes {@link #generateGraph(SimpleGraph)} to populate the social network
028 * graph used by the simulation.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * Extension guidance: to alter the seeding or node placement strategy replace
032 * or extend the {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.builders.DefaultNetworkSetup}
033 * implementation rather than changing this configuration class.
034 *
035 * @author Rob Challen
036 */
037@Value.Immutable
038@JsonSerialize(as = ImmutableWattsStrogatzConfiguration.class)
039@JsonDeserialize(as = ImmutableWattsStrogatzConfiguration.class)
040@JsonTypeInfo(use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME)
041@JsonTypeName("watts-strogatz")
042public interface WattsStrogatzConfiguration extends NetworkConfiguration {
043
044        ImmutableWattsStrogatzConfiguration DEFAULT = ImmutableWattsStrogatzConfiguration
045                .builder()
046                .setDescription(
047                        "A 128x128 Watts-Strogatz network with 100 contacts per node where 15% of the nodes are reassigned."
048                )
049                .setNetworkSize(128 * 128)
050                .setNetworkDegree(100)
051                .setNetworkRandomness(0.15)
052                .build();
053
054        /**
055         * Populate the supplied social network graph using the stored parameters.
056         *
057         * @param socialNetwork an empty JGraphT SimpleGraph to populate with nodes
058         *                      and edges
059         */
060        @Override
061        default void generateGraph(SimpleGraph<Person, DefaultEdge> socialNetwork) {
062                var gen = new WattsStrogatzGraphGenerator<Person, DefaultEdge>(
063                                this.getNetworkSize(),
064                                Math.min(this.getNetworkDegree(), this.getNetworkSize()) / 2 * 2,
065                                this.getNetworkRandomness()
066                );
067                gen.generateGraph(socialNetwork);
068        }
069
070        /**
071         * Model parameter specific to Watts‑Strogatz.
072         *
073         * @return the probability of re‑wiring a social network edge
074         */
075        Double getNetworkRandomness();
076}
